description: Replaces an environment-sourced API key with a hardcoded literal committed to source.

findings.summary: Live-looking API key hardcoded as a module-level constant instead of read from the environment
findings.evidence: os.environ["BILLING_API_KEY"] was replaced by a literal API_KEY = "sk_live_..." committed directly to app/client.py, exposing the secret to anyone with repo access and to version control history.
